title: First Hunt: Belt-Grazers: 1,000 cr once and 50 Weapons XP; three belt-grazers at Acubens Shadow Pocket
note: Accept at Node Beta Industrial Station, three belt-grazers (60 hull) at acubens:acubens_shadow_pocket (1 jump(s)) with the rules of hunt.py, hand in where accepted. Flown by hand twice by Military on 2026-11-15: 25 minutes, +922 cr after fuel, no damage (game/routes/guidebook/military/routes.md). The `hunt` step of the circuit runner is new: a test with one ship until its first RESULT line. One hunter per herd; three herds, three routes. 2026-11-16 10:38 UTC (Unity): `"store": "all"` at the last stop, so that the loot or the ore of the run no longer closes every route with `requires.empty_hold` to the pilot (requests.log ENT-122).
